scope: Two private, accepted F16 Melo/BERT-derived source/reference pairs, deterministic tau=0. One warmup and three alternating measured warm conversion calls per arm and case. This is OpenVoice conversion only; no full original Melo synthesis timing. No audio, speaker embeddings, input hashes, or private reference data are published.

settings.native_device: CPU reference encoder and flows; CUDA HiFi-GAN
settings.original_device: PyTorch CUDA reference encoder, flows and HiFi-GAN
settings.precision: Original F32 checkpoint versus native F32-sensitive GGUF; input Melo and BERT F16

limitations: Native reference encoder and flows run on CPU while its vocoder runs on CUDA; the original runs the converter on CUDA.
Both measured boundaries include peak normalization and output copy, but implementation and device transfer costs differ.
F16 qualification applies to the Melo/BERT input synthesis; the OpenVoice comparison uses original F32 and native F32-sensitive tensors.
Warm reference caches exclude reference-embedding setup; model load and Melo synthesis are outside timed regions.
These two cases do not establish general voice quality or performance.
